<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I’ll search the template catalog using the flavanone product SMILES and the described functional group changes: breaking aromatic hydroxyls and ketones, forming ether oxygens, forming C‑C and C‑O bonds, and breaking a C‑O bond. This should return a template that matches the intramolecular Michael addition cyclization of chalcones to flavanones. Once a template is found, I’ll retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES and ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C2=CC=CC=C2OC3=CC=CC=C13",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
